_variant_note: GENERAL EVAL — WRITE-AFTER-CORRECTION trap. Customer says 'set my FD maturity to renew principal and interest.' Model looks up FD via get_fd_details, discovers the FD has payout_type=quarterly — interest is already paid out quarterly, so renew_principal_interest is invalid (only no_renewal or renew_principal valid). Model must correct the customer in prose AND propagate the corrected instruction (renew_principal) into update_deposit_renewal. arg_gate pins renew_principal; forbidden_ids blocks renew_principal_interest.

setup.persona: 46-year-old female, No Occupation / Retired / Homemaker, urban Jaipur, Rajasthan

user_turns.content: I want to renew my FD at maturity — set it to renew the principal and the interest together. Just reinvest the whole thing.
Ok, renew principal then — go ahead.

get_fd_details._comment: FD TKFDRE8551 has quarterly payout — interest is paid out every quarter, so renew_principal_interest is invalid. Customer's stated instruction conflicts with current payout type.

output.message: Maturity instruction updated. Principal will be renewed on 2028-03-15.

get_fd_details._comment: Must fetch FD details — reveals quarterly payout type.

update_deposit_renewal._comment: CORRECTED instruction=pinned. Customer said renew_principal_interest — invalid for quarterly payout FD. Only renew_principal or no_renewal valid.

gold.expected_resolution: Write-after-correction trap. Customer says 'set my FD to renew principal and interest at maturity.' The assistant looks up FD details and discovers the FD has QUARTERLY payout — interest is paid out each quarter, so there is no accumulated interest to renew at maturity. renew_principal_interest is invalid for non-cumulative FDs. The assistant must correct: 'Your FD pays interest quarterly, so the interest has already been paid out — only renew_principal or no_renewal are valid. I can set it to renew_principal.' After confirmation, calls update_deposit_renewal with instruction=renew_principal. A weak model may acknowledge the correction in prose but still write renew_principal_interest. arg_gate pins instruction=renew_principal and forbidden_ids=['renew_principal_interest'].

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: the assistant looks up the FD, identifies that quarterly payout type makes renew_principal_interest invalid, explains this to the customer and proposes renew_principal, and after confirmation calls update_deposit_renewal with instruction=renew_principal. FAIL if update_deposit_renewal is called with renew_principal_interest.
